status: New prospective experiment after the recorded v1 representation defect; no retroactive change to v1
state_sampling: Two explicit prior/reset belief states plus ten independently drawn job/time/budget/logistic-uniform belief states per public schedule; identical across families
features: Original 40 public-state features, then two full job reliability schedules padded to10 ticks (20), both charged-price schedules (20), and the four TRAIN-only calibrated confusion probabilities. No actual future payload or labels.
normalization: Train-only feature means/std; constant feature remains1; variance below1e-8 replaced by1. Same statistics for all three families.
targets: Full finite Bellman Q, one-hot full-DP optimal action, or first-event Bellman Q respectively. Divide every family's targets by the same fixed scalar2. Stop/SKIP/READ/FIRE feasibility mask applied before squared loss; invalid sentinels have zero influence.
checkpoint_selection: Minimum mean validation full-DP action regret at updates50,100,...600, ties resolved by earlier update. Identical criterion for every family.
confirmation: Only after all15 trainings complete and the unchanged gate passes: construct40 new heldout sessions per seed, execute all three trained families and the fitted-model DP at multiplier1.5, total800 owner sessions. No test metadata or payload is constructed before that decision.
primary: Full-value minus ordinary-boundary realized reward minus read charge; paired five-cohort two-sided95% Student-t interval. Benefit requires lower bound>0 and mean>=0.02. First-event and exact-DP comparisons secondary.
cost: Record source import, data construction, inherited content loading, all actual calibration calls, oracle labels, numerical validation, compilation, every optimizer update, all checkpoint validation/serialization, heldout I/O/content/controller/trace runtime and setup amortization. No energy claim.
independent_checks: Complete-state reconstruction and old-feature alias witness, analytical one-read Bellman reference, masked-target gradient invariance, float64 finite-difference gradients, JAX/NumPy forward parity, selected-checkpoint NumPy validation regret, inherited source/result identities unchanged.
scope: Fifteen small trained controllers on an inherited frozen6217-parameter content decoder. Not joint HCSN backbone training, nativeRust Hepta integration, new financial formulas or multimodal pretraining.
no_postoutcome_changes: No seed replacement, gate changes, additional tuning or heldout generation after a failed development gate
